title: Television: John Lennon on Tomorrow | 1975
content:
John Lennon gave an interview to the US talk show Tomorrow on 8 April 1975.

It was filmed at the NBC Studios at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in Manhattan. The host was Tom Snyder.

Lennon discussed various subjects, including his recent reconciliation with Yoko Ono, their peace campaigns, and The Beatles’ break-up. He was joined for part of the interview by his lawyer Leon Wildes, and the conversation turned to Lennon’s long-running efforts to win US residency.

The interview was broadcast on NBC on 29 April at 1am EST.
